CustomField.description: Positional tier computed from rank data (ADP_Rank__c, or Experts_Rank__c if Draft_Settings__c.Ranking_Option__c is 'Fantasy Sharks') via gap-detection clustering within each Position__c group. Recomputed by MFLManagePlayers.managePlayers() on every sync. 1 is the best tier.
CustomField.label: Tier (Rank)
